13	
14	DESCRIPTION
15	-----------
16	
17	This command downloads the given URL into a fixed disk location, based on the
18	content of the retrieved file.
19	
20	This has been introduced to avoid a dependency on `curl` or `wget`, while also
21	promoting a more secure way to fetch data from the Internet. Use this instead
22	of `curl <url> | sh`.
23	
24	This command has two modes of operation:
25	
26	1. Just pass the URL to discover the integrity hash.
27	2. Pass the URL *and* the integrity hash to get back the on-disk location.
28	
29	Since the on-disk location is based on the hash, it also acts as a cache. One
30	implication of this design is that URLs must be stable and always return the
31	same content.
32	
33	Downloaded files are marked as read-only and executable so it can also be used
34	to fetch and execute static binaries.
35	
36	OPTIONS
37	-------
38	
39	<url>
40	    A HTTP URL that returns content on HTTP GET requests. 301 and other
41	    redirects are followed.
42	
43	<integrity-hash>

46	    specification (see https://www.w3.org/TR/SRI/ ).

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Test HTTP server for probing direnv fetchurl.

Routes:
  /ok            -> 200 text/plain "hello direnv\n"
  /bin           -> 200 application/octet-stream, bytes chosen so base64 has + and /
  /empty         -> 200 zero-length body
  /404           -> 404 with body
  /500           -> 500 with body
  /301           -> 301 Location: /ok
  /302           -> 302 Location: /ok
  /303 /307 /308 -> respective redirect to /ok
  /redirloop     -> 302 Location: /redirloop
  /chain/<n>     -> 302 Location: /chain/<n-1>, /chain/0 -> /ok
  /slow          -> 200 but sleeps 2s before body
  /noclen        -> chunked-ish
  /headers       -> echoes received headers as body
  /nobody204     -> 204
Everything logged to LOGFILE as JSON lines.
"""
import json
import os
import sys
import time
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

LOGFILE = os.environ.get("REQLOG", "/tmp/probe/fetchurl/reqlog.jsonl")

BINBODY = bytes(range(256))  # digest base64 will be checked separately


def log(entry):
    with open(LOGFILE, "a") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(entry) + "\n")
        f.flush()


class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
    server_version = "ProbeHTTP/1.0"
    sys_version = ""

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        sys.stderr.write("%s - %s\n" % (self.address_string(), fmt % args))

    def _record(self, method):
        log({
            "t": time.time(),
            "method": method,
            "path": self.path,
            "request_line": self.requestline,
            "protocol": self.request_version,
            "client": self.client_address[0],
            "headers": [[k, v] for k, v in self.headers.items()],
            "raw_headers": str(self.headers),
        })

    def _send(self, code, body=b"", ctype="text/plain", extra=None):
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", ctype)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        for k, v in (extra or []):
            self.send_header(k, v)
        self.end_headers()
        if body:
            self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_HEAD(self):
        self._record("HEAD")
        self._send(200)

    def do_GET(self):
        self._record("GET")
        p = self.path
        if p == "/ok":
            self._send(200, b"hello direnv\n")
        elif p == "/bin":
            self._send(200, BINBODY, "application/octet-stream")
        elif p == "/empty":
            self._send(200, b"")
        elif p == "/404":
            self._send(404, b"NOPE not found body\n")
        elif p == "/500":
            self._send(500, b"server exploded body\n")
        elif p == "/403":
            self._send(403, b"forbidden body\n")
        elif p in ("/301", "/302", "/303", "/307", "/308"):
            self._send(int(p[1:]), b"redirect body\n", extra=[("Location", "/ok")])
        elif p == "/301abs":
            self._send(301, b"", extra=[("Location", "http://127.0.0.1:%d/ok" % self.server.server_address[1])])
        elif p == "/redirloop":
            self._send(302, b"", extra=[("Location", "/redirloop")])
        elif p.startswith("/chain/"):
            n = int(p.split("/")[2])
            if n == 0:
                self._send(302, b"", extra=[("Location", "/ok")])
            else:
                self._send(302, b"", extra=[("Location", "/chain/%d" % (n - 1))])
        elif p == "/slow":
            time.sleep(2)
            self._send(200, b"slow body\n")
        elif p == "/headers":
            self._send(200, str(self.headers).encode())
        elif p == "/204":
            self.send_response(204)
            self.end_headers()
        elif p == "/big":
            body = b"x" * (1024 * 1024)
            self._send(200, body, "application/octet-stream")
        elif p == "/truncate":
            # Lies about content-length then closes
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", "100")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(b"short")
            self.close_connection = True
        elif p == "/gzip":
            import gzip
            body = gzip.compress(b"gzipped payload\n")
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
            self.send_header("Content-Encoding", "gzip")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)
        else:
            self._send(404, b"unknown route\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    port = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 8111
    srv = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), H)
    sys.stderr.write("listening on 127.0.0.1:%d\n" % port)
    srv.serve_forever()
